S7 Classes for the Solver of a Scoring Step

Source: R/solver.R
IwlsSolver.Rd

IwlsSolver is the abstract parent of the objects that select how the linear system of one step of iwls() is solved. Its three subclasses are SolveQR, SolveSVD and SolveChol. They are built by solve_qr(), solve_svd() and solve_chol(), which are the functions to call; the classes are exported so that S7::S7_inherits() can test an object. iwls_solvers compares the three.

SolveQR has the properties tol and floor, SolveSVD has tol and floor, and SolveChol has floor. The raw constructors do not validate them; the functions solve_qr(), solve_svd() and solve_chol() do.

Usage

IwlsSolver()

SolveQR(tol = integer(0), floor = integer(0))

SolveSVD(tol = NULL, floor = integer(0))

SolveChol(floor = integer(0))

Arguments

tol

For SolveQR, the tolerance of the pivoted QR, a single positive number. For SolveSVD, NULL or the relative cut of the singular values, a single positive number.

floor

The relative floor of the eigenvalues of a penalized matrix that is not positive definite, a single positive number.

Value

An S7 object of the class named, which inherits from IwlsSolver.

See also

iwls_solvers for the comparison of the three; solve_qr(), solve_svd() and solve_chol() for the constructors.

Examples

S7::S7_inherits(solve_svd(), IwlsSolver)
#> [1] TRUE
S7::S7_inherits(solve_svd(), SolveSVD)
#> [1] TRUE
solve_svd()@tol
#> NULL
